reviews.text: This is the best game I have ever played in my life!!! I love this game.

IF you're bored of the same old FPS games out there, you gotta check this one out. Choosing different bullets for different monsters is a breath of fresh air. I def bit the dust a few times for the first 15 mins, but once you figure it out, it's a total adrenaline rush! The multiplayer experience was a whole other level of chaos. My friends and I loved the frantic moments of us desperately trying to load the right bullet before getting wiped out lol
Game is pretty epic. Parallels my life as a basement dweller where I'm constantly fighting spiders, internet trolls, and crippling schizophrenia. Big recommend.

Clever game where you reload different bullets to kill different enemies. I thought the difficulty was perfect and took me a little over an hour to beat the game after a few attempts. Now there's endless mode and multiplayer to enjoy. A few of the items I didn't really get what they do but should click sooner or later. Worth the price of a beer.

Don't let the negative mark make you think the game is bad, it's really fun, however I have a big complaint with it. For the current content available, the game is what I would call overpriced. While 8 bucks isn't a lot of money, the game barely delivered me an hour worth of content. This game would be really great if it just got more content and updates, it has fun mechanics just needs more time in the oven. The game is cool, mechanics are fun, but in its current state (Of which I believe the developer has said it's finished) it's not worth it IMO. If things change, I'll definitely change the review to a positive one because in the short amount of content delivered I had a lot of fun.

The map layouts and fun reload system require a lot of strategy and forethought, allowing a high skill ceiling despite the seemingly simple and straightforward mechanics. Collecting bestiary entries and piecing together lore is really fun, and the kill counters on the specific entries are a great way to measure your progression. The game even has an awesome endless mode, one of the most important things to me in any game. To top it off, Monster Bullets features a charming art style and a soundtrack that really gets you in the mood for slaying creatures of myth with conventional firearms. 10/10
It has a pretty unique gimmick for a boomer shooter game. It is an overall enjoyable gaming experience.
